home.about_text: I like getting outdoors and working on projects I can build with my hands.

about.title: About Me
about.heading: Background & Interests
paragraphs: I’m Drew, a mechanical engineering student at CU Boulder. I like figuring out how things work and then seeing what I can make or improve myself.
One of my favorite parts of mechanical engineering is going between CAD and hands-on work. I can work out how parts should fit on screen, then build something and see how it actually fits.
about.opportunity_text: I’m looking for a mechanical engineering internship where I can work on a design from CAD through prototyping and testing.

details.heading: Engineering Interests
details.text: I’m especially interested in cars and the mechanical design behind them. I’d also like to learn more about aerospace and clean energy.

details.heading: Outside Class
details.text: Outside of class, I like backpacking, camping, and skiing.

contact.heading: Engineering Internship Opportunities
contact.text: I’m currently seeking mechanical engineering internship opportunities. You can reach me by email or connect with me on LinkedIn.
